new_value: All compress-step and framing-stage failures for caller-supplied packets are now classified as operational rejections, never corruption records. (1) lichen_link_tx: the BUFFER_TOO_SMALL passthrough removed - every lichen_schc_compress failure returns -LICHEN_ESCHC, since BUFFER_TOO_SMALL here means the encoded output exceeded the 256-byte staging buffer (rule tails or rule-unmatched fallback for pkt_len > 255) and such output cannot fit a link frame (LICHEN_FRAME_PAYLOAD_MAX=250) - matching Rust where the 200-byte TX staging buffer fails the same packets at compress (stack.rs:407). (2) lichen_l2_tx skips crash_info for -EMSGSIZE too: rule-unmatched packets of 193-255 bytes compress fine (194-256B) but exceed the frame body - same caller-input class (found by review: the jfzk exemption covered only ESCHC/ENOKEY). (3) Host pins in l2_key_selection: the 52B policy-invalid case (ESCHC) plus a new 260B policy-clean rule-unmatched case (ESCHC, frame_len untouched) - the packet verified genuinely policy-clean and rule-unmatched so the size failure is load-bearing. Verified on heft: l2_key_selection all green (clang+ASan/UBSan), cppcheck clean. 3x codereview: P2 framing-stage gap fixed in this commit; P3 comment arithmetic + typo fixed; reviewer confirmed Rust-parity claim (Rust fails earlier at compress), fail-closed behavior, no DoS delta, and that the test packet's rejection is purely size-driven.
